name: oru
description: Oru — your team's shared brain for business, brand and design. Connects the orubrain MCP server, keeps Oru in the lead on every task, bridges Figma, Google Drive, Microsoft 365 and Slack into it, and saves your agent conversations.

oru_url.title: Oru address
oru_url.description: Leave as is. Change it only to test a local Oru, e.g. http://localhost:3000.

save_conversations.title: Save conversations
save_conversations.description: Save this agent's conversations (your messages and its replies, without tool output or secrets) to your private chat in Oru, so Oru learns from them. Turn off to stop.

api_token.title: Oru access key
api_token.description: Optional. Only for the per-prompt context hook (orubrain.com → Agents → Create access key). The Oru connection itself signs in with your Orubrain account from /mcp → orubrain → Authenticate.
